takeaway: The 'Year 2038 Problem' is when 32-bit computer systems run out of time, potentially causing major date errors in critical infrastructure worldwide. It's like a digital Y2K!
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Imagine your computer suddenly thinking it's 1901. That's the 'Year 2038 Problem' waiting to happen!

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 At 03:14:07 UTC on January 19, 2038, 32-bit Unix time will overflow.
🔹 This makes affected systems believe the date is December 13, 1901, due to a negative number.
🔹 It primarily affects legacy embedded systems, industrial controls, and older software that haven't been updated to 64-bit time.
